item.title: Wreaths to be laid for Holocaust Memorial Day
item.description: NINETEEN descendants of survivors of the Holocaust will attend Jersey’s Holocaust Memorial Day this year. On Tuesday 27 January, 44 wreaths will be laid at the Lighthouse Memorial on the New North Quay in memory of the victims of Nazi persecution in the Second World War.
